integrity: The finite claim is proved by exhaustive enumeration of all 243 elements of the displayed subspace with two exact nilpotency criteria and an exact rank check.
scientific_limitations: The result is an explicit dimension-five lower bound only. It neither proves maximality nor rules out the conjectural dimension-six subspace. Literature equivalence under unsearched coordinate changes remains a residual originality risk.
title: A five-dimensional nilpotent-free subspace of \(M_3(\mathbb F_3)\)
